name: Architecture Assessment Framework
description: Standard framework for assessing an existing software architecture

domains.name: Business Context
domains.description: Understanding of business goals, drivers, and constraints

scoringCriteria.description: Business goals are unclear or not documented
Basic business goals exist but lack detail
Business goals are documented and understood
Goals are well-defined with measurable KPIs
Goals are strategic, measurable, and regularly reviewed

domains.name: Architecture
domains.description: Quality, suitability, and maturity of the current software architecture

scoringCriteria.description: No documented architecture; ad hoc design
Basic architecture exists but is not well documented or maintained
Architecture is documented, follows patterns, covers main concerns
Architecture is well-designed, documented, reviewed, and maintained
Architecture is exemplary with clear evolution strategy

domains.name: Security & IAM
domains.description: Security posture, identity management, and access control

scoringCriteria.description: Minimal security controls; no IAM strategy
Basic auth/authz exists but gaps in coverage
Standard security practices implemented; IAM in place
Comprehensive security with monitoring and incident response
Security-first culture with automated controls and regular audits

domains.name: Integrations & APIs
domains.description: API design, integration patterns, and third-party dependencies

scoringCriteria.description: Ad hoc integrations; no API strategy
Some APIs exist but inconsistent design
APIs follow consistent patterns; integrations documented
API-first design; versioning, documentation, monitoring
Mature API platform with governance and self-service

domains.name: Cloud & Infrastructure
domains.description: Cloud strategy, infrastructure maturity, and operational readiness

scoringCriteria.description: Manual infrastructure; no cloud strategy
Some cloud services used; limited automation
Cloud-native approach with IaC and standard patterns
Mature cloud platform with automation and governance
Platform engineering with self-service and policy-as-code

domains.name: DevOps / CI-CD
domains.description: Development practices, CI/CD maturity, and deployment automation

scoringCriteria.description: Manual builds and deployments
Basic CI exists; manual deployments
CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and deployment
Mature CI/CD with quality gates, progressive rollout
Fully automated with canary/blue-green and rollback

domains.name: Observability
domains.description: Monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational visibility

scoringCriteria.description: Minimal logging; no monitoring
Basic logging and some monitoring
Structured logging, metrics, and alerting
Full observability stack with tracing and dashboards
Proactive observability with SLOs, automated remediation

domains.name: Non-Functional Requirements
domains.description: Coverage and implementation of NFRs (performance, scalability, availability, etc.)

scoringCriteria.description: NFRs not defined or addressed
Some NFRs mentioned but not measured
NFRs defined and partially implemented
NFRs defined, measured, and actively managed
NFRs continuously validated with automated testing
